rationale: Orchestrate 0.7.1 is a prompt-audit release: SKILL.md wording (the delegation rule, explorers only where step 2's targeted reads are not enough), the restored 'Hypotheses to confirm' heading in references/routing.md, new AGENTS.md rules on contract and error-path tests, and the loop's SCRIPT_VERSION 0.7.0 -> 0.7.1 with no other loop change. The shipped workflows/orchestrate-execute.js is replaced by the upstream file at 6679439 byte for byte (tests.test_workflows compares it with the submodule, and workflow_steps reads its SCRIPT_VERSION for the args). The SKILL.md and routing wording is orchestrate's own coordinator prompt, which Delivery does not ship, so it is not adopted. Mapped files also changed by two local 1.4.0 fixes: the gate step in workflow_steps.py passes a task gate's planned timeout (--timeout), run_engine.py validates and uses planned gate and case timeouts (1-3600 s, default 300) and records timeout_seconds in the receipt, delivery.py's gate --timeout defaults to the plan, and run-contract.md and host-execution.md document it; capture_verification refuses a changed gitlink (submodule_changed) using new snapshots.py helpers, and README.md notes that unchanged submodules are supported. PROVENANCE.md carries the new source rows and a 1.4.0 sync section. The loop contract is unchanged.
reviewer: Independent read-only review of release/1.4.0 (commits b277b27..8f615d1) on October 2, 2026: PASS for the upstream diffs (orchestrate wording and SCRIPT_VERSION; factory factory-small wording, nothing vendored; spec scalar/parse_simple_yaml AST-identical to e9c04b6), submodule handling (rename, type change, added gitlink and a non-ASCII path probed), gate timeouts (bool, float, string, 0, 3601 and None refused; precedence explicit > planned > 300), records and lock (upstreams.py status ok) and versions. It raised one finding, fixed in a follow-up commit with its tests: staged_gitlink_changes used git diff-index --cached, which obeys submodule.<name>.ignore=all, so a gitlink move in such a repository passed the early check; the call now passes --ignore-submodules=none. A separate error-path review found no defect (an old run.json without timeout, old snapshots without a gitlinks key, a refusal leaving run.json unchanged). The follow-up fix was not re-reviewed independently. Review prose does not authenticate identity.
tests: Regression tests written first and seen failing before their fixes on October 2, 2026: tests.test_snapshots test_gitlink_is_recorded_without_content, test_changed_gitlink_between_snapshots_is_reported, test_staged_gitlink_change_is_found_before_capture; tests.test_rich_integration test_unchanged_submodule_does_not_block_capture_verification (red: UNSUPPORTED_TREE) and test_changed_gitlink_refuses_capture_verification_with_a_clear_code (red: DIRECTORY_SCOPE instead of submodule_changed); tests.test_run_engine GateTimeoutTests (six tests; red: planned timeouts ignored and accepted unvalidated, no timeout_seconds) and tests.test_workflows test_the_gate_step_passes_each_planned_gate_timeout (red: no --timeout passed). All pass after the fixes. Full suite on October 2, 2026 before this record, on the final code (one later docstring-only edit in snapshots.py): tools tests 20/20 and the plug-in catalog 529/529 in eight shards, 0 skipped, 0 failures. make check after this record. No live host run of 1.4.0 yet.
